## ACT I · TEAM & PROBLEM (`0:00 – 1:08` | Slides 1–3)
*Delivery tip: Start warm and energetic on Slide 1, then drop noticeably **quieter and slower** on Slide 2 so a room of 30 teams instantly hushes and leans in.*

### `[Slide 1 · 0:00]` — Team Intro (`PlayIT · Group 56`)
> *(Smile, stand tall, sweep eye contact left → center → right across the judges.)*  
> "Good afternoon, judges! We are **PlayIT**—Group 56 from CIT-University: Zendrix, Erik, Ashlee, Kaysean, and John James, mentored by Mr. Joemarie Amparo. Today, let’s start with one child." `[CLICK → Slide 2]`

### `[Slide 2 · 0:12]` — Meet Mia *(Quiet Hook — Problem)*
> *(Pause 1s as dusk morphs in. Lower your voice slightly.)*  
> "Picture a kitchen table in Bohol at seven-thirty tonight. That’s **Mia**. Age six. Grade 1—staring at **one small letter** under her lamp. One sound… she just can’t remember.  
> Crowded classroom. Nanay still at work. And the phone beside her? **Zero signal.**  
> *(Hold 1.2s of silence. Look straight at the judges.)*  
> When nobody at home can answer **one sound**? *(Drop voice gently)* Mia closes the book." `[CLICK → Slide 3]`

### `[Slide 3 · 0:38]` — Scale the Problem (`9 out of 10`)
> *(Voice lifts — firm, urgent, clear.)*  
> "Mia is **not** the exception. *(Pause 0.6s)* According to the June 2022 World Bank and UNESCO Brief, **90.9 percent**—**nine out of ten** Filipino ten-year-olds—struggle to read a simple text.  
> Existing apps leave families trapped behind two walls: cloud apps freeze without Wi-Fi, and four-to-six-hundred-peso paywalls are built for foreign accents." `[CLICK → Slide 4]`

## ACT II · PROPOSED SOLUTION & CORE VALUE (`1:08 – 2:10` | Slide 4)
*Delivery tip: Smile—energy turns warm and hopeful. Gesture smoothly across the 4 colored cards behind you.*

### `[Slide 4 · 1:08]` — PlayIT: Offline Phonics in 4 Steps + Parent Zone
> "So we stopped waiting for better Wi-Fi—and built **PlayIT**. *(Pause 0.6s)* Guided by **Lily the Tarsier**, PlayIT turns any entry-level Android 8 phone families already own into a patient phonics tutor—built in Kotlin with **zero internet permission**, following DepEd’s **Marungko** order: **M, S, A, I** first.  
>
> Every letter takes four beats.  
> **One, Hear It:** Lily models pure `/m/` and **Mouse**.  
> **Two, Say It—our core breakthrough:** embedded **Vosk** offline AI checks Mia’s speech right on the phone at **zero cloud cost**. *(Pause 0.5s)* Miss twice? No harsh buzzer. *(Soften tone)* Lily quietly shows **how to shape her lips**—zero hearts lost.  
> **Three, Find It:** five hearts tapping Mouse, Mom, and Map.  
> **Four, Blend It:** tiles snap into **SAM, SIS, AM**, saved offline in Room SQLite.  
>
> And for parents? One tap exports an offline **A4 PDF progress report** across all twenty-six letters—backed by **691 passing tests out of 697**, **zero failures**." `[CLICK → Slide 5]`

## ACT III · PROOF, VALUE PROPOSITION & POTENTIAL IMPACT (`2:10 – 4:35` | Slides 5–9)
*Delivery tip: Conversational confidence. Land each headline number, pause half a beat, then tie it directly to **value** and **impact**.*

### `[Slide 5 · 2:10]` — Early Field Proof (`Tested with 30 People`)
> "We didn’t just build a prototype—we tested PlayIT with **thirty people**, the real **bridge to Mia**.  
> **Fifteen of sixteen** Grade 1 learners chose the happiest face, and **fourteen** asked to play again. Parents rated Grade 1 fit **4.6 out of 5** with a **75.5** usability score. And five teachers on our final sixteen-item rubric scored the teaching design **4.73 out of 5**—with nine teachers involved across both rounds." `[CLICK → Slide 6]`
> *(Internal reminder: we measured engagement, usability, and pedagogy—reading gains come in our 6-week pilot.)*

### `[Slide 6 · 2:40]` — Market & Potential Impact (`TAM / SAM / SOM`)
> "Look at the **potential impact** of that bridge. Across Southeast Asia and the Philippines, **13.5 million** early learners form a **₱16.2 billion** market. Nationally, **2.4 million** Filipino Grade 1 learners need foundational phonics—and right here in Region VII, **185,000** learners anchor our **₱18 to ₱36 million** Cebu beachhead, directly supporting DepEd’s **National Learning Recovery Program**." `[CLICK → Slide 7]`

### `[Slide 7 · 3:08]` — Accessible Business Model (`4 Revenue Streams`)
> "To maximize reach without pricing out low-income families, Chapter 1—M, S, A, I—is **free forever**. Parents unlock all seven chapters for **₱149 a month** or a **₱999** one-time GCash voucher—less than three tutor sessions. Schools license at **₱450** per student yearly, alongside **₱75,000** LGU Special Education Fund kits and **₱150,000** CSR school adoptions." `[CLICK → Slide 8]`

### `[Slide 8 · 3:35]` — Clear Value Proposition (`Why PlayIT Wins`)
> *(Gesture across the rival columns, landing firmly on the Gold PlayIT column.)*  
> "That’s our **value proposition**. Cloud apps **stall** without Wi-Fi. Flashcard apps are **blind**—they can’t hear whether a child spoke right. Tutors cost **₱3,000+ a month**. Across **seven** reading apps we reviewed, **only PlayIT** unites zero-internet offline use, on-device Vosk speech checking, DepEd Marungko order, and offline A4 reporting." `[CLICK → Slide 9]`

### `[Slide 9 · 4:02]` — Zero-Data Scale & Unit Economics
> "We scale through the **classroom door**. Phase 1: a proposed six-week fluency pilot across **one to five Cebu schools**. Phase 2: during **Brigada Eskwela**, teachers beam `playit.apk` phone-to-phone via **Nearby Share**—reaching rural homes at **₱0 mobile data** and **₱0 ad spend**—before expanding to twenty Visayas schools, LGU SEF kits nationwide, and **Bisaya and Tagalog** modules.  
>
> Because speech AI runs on the phone at **₱0 cloud cost**, we project an **88 percent gross margin**, **4.8× LTV-to-CAC**, break-even at **985 passes**, and **₱1.45 million** Year 1 revenue growing to **₱5.80 million** in Year 2." `[CLICK → Slide 10]`

## Rapid Semi-Finals Q&A Defense Card

1. **Can we see the app work offline right now?**  
   *(Pull out your test phone already on **Airplane Mode**!)* Tap `Say It` on Letter `M` -> speak `"Mouse"` -> show instant Vosk recognition with zero Wi-Fi/data, then miss twice to show Lily's mouth-shape cue, then tap Parent Zone -> A4 PDF! *(A 15-second Airplane Mode demo wins rooms instantly!)*
2. **Did children actually improve their reading?**  
   "Our `N = 30` capstone evaluation measured learner engagement (`15/16` happiest face), parent usability (`75.5` SUS), and teacher pedagogy (`4.73/5`). Measuring reading fluency gains directly is the exact goal of our proposed 6-week Cebu school pilot."
3. **What makes PlayIT different from other EdTech / literacy apps today?**  
   "Three things together: zero `INTERNET` permission (`₱0` cloud AI cost via embedded Vosk), DepEd's exact Marungko sequence (`M, S, A, I`), and phone-to-phone Nearby Share distribution for low-connectivity households."
4. **How do offline GCash / voucher unlocks prevent piracy?**  
   "Signed offline activation codes bound to device ID and stored in Room SQLite—redeemed once offline after GCash or school purchase, with no recurring cloud servers needed."
5. **Why is the APK ~114 MB, and what about ElevenLabs audio before commercial launch?**  
   "The Vosk speech model and audio ship inside the APK so families pay `₱0` mobile data after one Nearby Share transfer. Four academic clips (`AM`, `TUB`, `YAM`, `/i/`) used ElevenLabs Free Tier (credited in Parent Zone) and swap to Apache-2.0 `Kokoro-82M` before commercial launch."
